pages.label: Motorized Shading
pages.decision: Choose fabric and privacy needs per opening, then compare Lutron hardware, size and power paths, and exposed versus concealed details.

pages.label: Home Intelligence
pages.decision: Choose a focused room, a whole-residence system, or a supported takeover path; choose how the family will control it.

pages.label: Architectural Lighting
pages.decision: Choose lighting layers, a Lutron platform and keypad approach, and a construction route that matches the fixtures and rooms.

pages.label: Media & Audio
pages.decision: Shortlist speakers and counts by room, a TV by light and seats, a media-room audio layout, and the Control4 actions the family will use.

pages.label: Private Cinemas
pages.decision: Decide whether a dedicated room is justified, then settle seating, image, speaker geometry, acoustic work and construction scope.

pages.label: Security Cameras & Access Control
pages.decision: Set the events to observe and privacy exclusions, then choose camera detail, storage and entry permissions.

pages.label: Digital Infrastructure & Privacy
pages.decision: Distinguish internet service from in-home coverage, then plan wired backhaul, Wi-Fi, network separation and serviceable equipment.

pages.label: Outdoor Entertainment
pages.decision: Map listening and viewing zones, then select appropriate outdoor speakers, display exposure, control and weather-safe routes.
